title: Hobie First Cast Program
seo_title: Hobie First Cast Guided Kayak Fishing | Ottawa, IL
seo_description: Try kayak fishing with local Hobie Fishing Pros. Hobie First Cast guided outings from Quest Watersports in Ottawa, IL include a kayak, safety gear and tackle.
body_html:
Hobie First Cast makes it easier than ever to experience fishing from a Hobie kayak. Spend a few hours on a guided tour with local and regional Hobie Fishing Pros to:

  • Learn fishing basics from people who know where and how to catch fish locally
  • Try a Hobie kayak on the water for the complete kayak fishing experience
  • Meet new people, have a great time on the water, and create some new fish stories

Cost and what is included

Cost is $100 per participant, which includes use of a Hobie fishing kayak, water safety equipment, and basic gear and tackle (feel free to bring your own). The First Cast fee may be applied to a Hobie kayak purchase for up to one year after your outing.

Age requirements

Anglers under 18 must present a signed parent/guardian liability waiver, and those under 16 must be accompanied by a participating parent/guardian.

Book your spot

Watch our homepage for scheduled outing dates, or let us know if you would like to arrange a specific date for yourself or a small group. Call 815.433.2200 or email hobie@questwatersports.com.

Fish on!

Next steps: learn about kayak fishing, shop Hobie kayaks, or try a free demo ride.
